messages:
ellie (AE): Heads-up  Prospect wants to sign POC orderform but it's multi-entity: PO will come from local subsidiary, MSA executed by parent. They also sent a DPA with subprocessor redlines and asked for a KMS/HSM attestation. Question: what's the safest routing for signature and do we need countersign from legal on the OF? Need this live by COB tomorrow.

mark (sales-ops): Order form in drive: https://drive.internal/po/mobility-poc. Amounts: $9,500 POC + $3,500 activation. Template candidate = "OrderForm-MultiEntity-v1". DocuSign template link: https://docusign.internal/templates/OF-ME-v1.

juan (finance): $9.5k under sales manager threshold. We still need billing contact + tax id from the subsidiary. AP prefers PO attached to envelope and PO_NUMBER as custom field. For multi-entity, AP wants invoice made out to the PO-issuing entity.

toni (legal): DPA redlines noted: they added a subprocessors clause and a residency paragraph ("customer data must remain in EU"). If the DPA materially changes residency obligations, we cannot accept without infra confirmation. Legal shouldn't sign the OF unless the MSA/DPA has non-standard SLA or indemnity language. We can be set as reviewer in the envelope and countersign the MSA only if required.

sec-bot: Quick checklist: provide SOC2 link (https://security.redwood/soc2), KMS attestation template at https://legal.internal/templates/kms-attest-v2.docx, and list of subprocessors: https://legal.internal/subprocessors/current.csv. If they demand physical HSM vendor proof, expect 24-48h for infra to validate.

ellie (AE): Buyer insists both PO and signed DPA be in place before POC start. They want the KMS attestation included in the same envelope if possible. They also want our CFO (customer side) to sign the orderform.

mark (sales-ops): Proposed signer order for DocuSign: 1) AE placeholder (ellie) 2) Sales Manager 3) Finance(billing) 4) Customer CFO 5) Customer PO issuer (if separate) — legal as reviewer. We can add custom fields: PO_NUMBER and BILLING_ENTITY. If MSA needs countersign, we'll switch to two-envelope flow (OF + MSA) or have MSA countersigned by legal.

juan (finance): We prefer PO attached. For multi-entity invoices, mark billing entity in envelope metadata. If the customer's PO issuer signs after customer CFO, AP wants the PO to be present earlier; consider sending MSA+OF together so signatures align.

toni (legal): If DPA redlines change data residency, do not send envelope until infra confirms we can guarantee region-bound keys. Otherwise attach our standard DPA and KMS addendum and set legal as reviewer. If the customer insists on redlined DPA signature, we need 48h.

ellie (AE): Customer responded: they'll accept our standard DPA and the addendum for now, but they asked us to state a firm commitment in the OF that keys for EU data will be stored in EU region. Can legal sign that?

toni (legal): We can include a written attestation (non-warranty) that keys for EU data are stored in the EU region when the customer requests region binding. That's fine as an addendum. We'll not sign the OF for that alone; legal review + internal infra confirmation required if they ask for warranty language.

sec-bot: Note: addendum language suggestion: "Redwood will store cryptographic keys used to protect Customer EU data in EU-based, HSM-backed key stores, unless otherwise agreed." Infrastructure must confirm HSM availability in target region.

mark (sales-ops): Flow decision: proceed with single envelope containing OF + DPA (standard) + KMS addendum. SignerOrder = ["ae","sales_mgr","finance","customer_cfo","customer_po_entity"] with legal as reviewer. If infra later says HSM not available, we'll redline and escalate.

juan (finance): OK from finance provided billing entity metadata is set and PO attached. AP needs invoice entity mapping.

toni (legal): I'll prepare KMS addendum and upload: https://legal.internal/drafts/kms-add-mobility-v1.docx. Keep legal as reviewer. If customer sends redlines for the DPA calling out subprocessors list changes, hold the envelope.

ellie (AE): Buyer will send PO tonight. I'll push that they sign the OF + attachments in one go. If they insist on countersigned DPA, we might need to delay.

mark (sales-ops): When PO lands I'll populate PO_NUMBER and BILLING_ENTITY fields and send envelope with template OF-ME-v1. Example override: {"templateId":"OF-ME-v1","signerOrder":["ae","sales_mgr","finance","customer_cfo","customer_po_entity"]} (api).

juan (finance): FYI: if they request Net45, we require director approval. Otherwise Net30 default. We'll invoice per billing entity.

toni (legal): Draft uploaded. I'll monitor for any DPA redlines. If none, proceed with envelope send.

ellie (AE): PO arrived. Mark - please send envelope. I'm standing by for signatures.

mark (sales-ops): Envelope sent with attachments and signer order. PO_NUMBER and BILLING_ENTITY set. Legal marked as reviewer. Notifying AP. :white_check_mark:

juan (finance): AP has received the PO copy. We'll process invoices after signature.

toni (legal): Watching for post-sign DPA edits. If customer later asks for warranty language on keys, escalate to infra + legal.

ellie (AE): Thanks team — will confirm POC start when fully executed. Closing thread once signed. :rocket:
